definitions.explanation: Time off from work or school.

⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{休|やす}みましょう→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}する→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
{休|やす}みなく⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休|やす}みです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are you off on the weekend?

⟦{冬休|ふゆやす}み→冬休み：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。

notes:
{休|やす}み is a noun meaning rest, break, or vacation (derived from the verb {休|やす}む).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {休|やす}みを{取|と}る: to take a break/day off
- {休|やす}みの{日|ひ}: day off
- {休|やす}みなく: without rest, continuously
- お{休|やす}みなさい: good night (greeting)

VACATION COMPOUNDS:
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter vacation
- {春休|はるやす}み: spring break
- ゴールデンウィーク: Golden Week (late April-early May)

BREAK COMPOUNDS:
- {昼休|ひるやす}み: lunch break
- {休憩|きゅうけい}: rest period, intermission

WORD FORMATION:
Nominalized form of {休|やす}む (to rest). Many Japanese nouns are formed by taking the verb stem ({連用形|れんようけい}).
